title: Application of Commonwealth Electric Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 98, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly Power Cost Charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings commencing in the billing months of April, May and June, 1985. the Power Cost Charge reflects changes in prudently incurred, reasonable costs of fuels and power purchased by the Company. Application is also made by Commonwealth Electric Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifing Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and M.D.P.U. 106. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filing to be made by utilities with the Department, and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
